body.description: Balelet: a small square hay baler creature, green farm-machine body with a pickup reel mouth that gobbles hay, a little chute on its back puffing straw, wheels, stubborn worker. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
